description: This file defines the AndroidBackHandler class, which manages listeners for Android back button events in a React Native web context, supporting adding, removing, and notifying event listeners with fallback handling.

classes.name: AndroidBackHandler
classes.description: A class for managing callback listeners for Android back button events, including setting fallback behavior and notifying registered listeners.

methods.name: setFallbackListener
methods.description: Sets a fallback listener that is invoked if no other listener handles the back event.

methods.name: addEventListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for back events; returns a function to remove this listener.

methods.name: notifyEvent
methods.description: Invokes the registered listeners in reverse order until one handles the event; calls fallback if none handle it.
